# Two of the poison- cases below are goldens BECAUSE of the reserved vocabulary
# rather than in spite of it (profile §3.1, §5.1): a quad written in exactly the
# shape the lowering emits IS the statement-layer row it spells, so it is folded
# back into the statement layer instead of being refused. Every other use of the
# reserved namespace refuses exactly as before, and the two folded cases carry the
# fold's own evidence — poison-forgery spells a reifier row, poison-sentinel-graph
# spells an annotation row, and each canonicalizes to the row it spelled.
